name: Lekkala Jeyavardhan

hero.title: I build things to *see* how they work.
hero.lede: Shells, flight computers, robots, and the guides that explain them.

about.a: A builder from India who likes to understand what happens underneath. I write C when I want to see the machine, and I wire up sensors when I want to see the physics.
ForgeShell, a Unix shell with a field guide that explains every line, and a rocket that steers by tilting its motor.

projects.name: ForgeShell
projects.blurb: A resource-aware Unix shell in C: pipelines, job control and live /proc process monitoring.

projects.name: TVC Rocket
projects.blurb: A rocket that steers by tilting its single motor, with a control loop holding it upright.

projects.name: Flight Telemetry
projects.blurb: A 3D flight telemetry dashboard fed by STM32 sensor fusion over Web Serial.

projects.name: Robo Soccerbot
projects.blurb: A four-wheel robot soccer bot built from scratch, with the whole journey written down.
